title: An unmasked Rey becomes a giant killer
summary: Rey Mysterio loses his mask to the Outsiders, then answers the humiliation by challenging much larger opponents. His first response is an upset against Kevin Nash.

chapters.title: The Outsiders win Rey’s mask
chapters.result: Hall and Nash defeat Mysterio and Konnan in a hair-versus-mask match.
chapters.context: The result forces Rey to unmask, while Elizabeth keeps her hair.

chapters.title: Rey upsets Nash
chapters.result: Mysterio pins Nash in their singles match.
chapters.context: One night after losing his mask, the smaller wrestler begins rebuilding his identity through giant-killing victories.
